instruction: Install and configure HAProxy with automatic failover
output:
cat > /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg << 'EOF'
defaults
  log global
  option httplog
  timeout connect 5s
  timeout client 50s
  timeout server 50s
frontend main
  bind *:80
  default_backend app
backend app
  option httpchk GET /health
  server app1 192.168.1.10:80 check fall 3 rise 2
  server app2 192.168.1.11:80 check fall 3 rise 2 backup
EOF && systemctl restart haproxy

instruction: Set up HAProxy with ACL-based routing
output:
cat > /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg << 'EOF'
frontend http-in
  bind *:80
  acl is_api path_beg /api
  acl is_static path_beg /static
  use_backend api if is_api
  use_backend static if is_static
  default_backend web
backend api
  server api1 127.0.0.1:3000 check
backend static
  server static1 127.0.0.1:8000 check
backend web
  server web1 127.0.0.1:8080 check
EOF && systemctl restart haproxy

instruction: Set up HAProxy with TCP health checks
output:
echo -e 'backend db
  option tcp-check
  tcp-check connect
  tcp-check send PING
  tcp-check expect string +PONG
  server db1 192.168.1.10:6379 check inter 3s' >> /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg && systemctl restart haproxy

instruction: Install and configure Pound (reverse proxy)
output:
apt install -y pound && cat > /etc/pound/pound.cfg << 'EOF'
ListenHTTP
  Address 0.0.0.0
  Port 80
  Service
    BackEnd
      Address 127.0.0.1
      Port 8080
    End
  End
EOF && systemctl restart pound

instruction: Set up Nginx with fail2ban to block bad requests
output:
cat > /etc/fail2ban/jail.d/nginx.conf << 'EOF'
[nginx-http-auth]
enabled = true
port = http,https
logpath = %(nginx_error_log)s
maxretry = 5
bantime = 3600
EOF && systemctl restart fail2ban

instruction: Create an Nginx geoip blocklist
output: apt install -y libnginx-mod-http-geoip && echo -e 'geoip_country /usr/share/GeoIP/GeoIP.dat;\nif ($geoip_country_code ~ (CN|RU|KP)) { return 403; }' >> /etc/nginx/nginx.conf && nginx -s reload
